verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh's case management lets analysts prioritise and review risk alerts. Cases can be filtered by risk, stage, assignee and creation date, assigned to agents, decided, and audited. Transaction monitoring cases and alerts are a documented case type. However, nothing shows analysts can manually group multiple related subjects and transactions into a single investigation. missing for 10: documented ability to group multiple subjects/transactions into one investigation, explicit alert prioritisation controls (e.g., priority scoring or ordering), independent or hands-on corroboration.
